lane: Bibliography-support fetch for the Circle blog post's first Wayback capture
target: Circle blog post "An Update on USDC and Silicon Valley Bank" (bib key circle2023update), first Wayback capture timestamp

queries.query: exact-URL CDX, full history (no from/to bound)
queries.sort_order: ascending by timestamp (verified: rows already sorted, no explicit &sort= param needed)

queries.query: URL-variant sweep (confirms CDX urlkey canonicalization collapses http/https and www/non-www to the same capture set -- not a coincidence of one particular URL string)
queries.result: all three variants return urlkey 'com,circle)/blog/an-update-on-usdc-and-silicon-valley-bank' with the identical first three rows (first capture 20230311202753) as the canonical https://www.circle.com/... query -- confirms 20230311202753 is the first capture across every URL-scheme/subdomain form, not an artifact of one query.

queries.query: snapshot fetch of the first capture (raw, id_ suffix)
queries.note: Wayback served this with Content-Encoding: gzip; the response was fetched with curl --compressed to decode it (a first attempt without that flag saved the raw gzip stream and was discarded/re-fetched). Decoded HTML matches its <title>/og:title ('An Update on USDC and Silicon Valley Bank') and contains the make-whole pledge language the manuscript cites -- confirms this capture is the correct page body, not a redirect/placeholder.
